```plato
    //==
    // # Planar signed distance primitives
    //
    // The planar half of the primitive family, under the same portability rules as
    // the spatial one above: scalar and fixed-arity vector arithmetic only. Each is
    // the 2D counterpart of a spatial primitive — circle to sphere, ring to torus,
    // line to plane — except that the 2D box already serves as the cylinder, which
    // is why there is no separate planar capped-cylinder form.

    // The signed distance from a point to a circle of the given radius centred at
    // the origin. Exact. (IQ: sdCircle.)
    DistanceToCircle(p: Point2D, radius: Number): Number
        => p.PositionVector.Magnitude - radius;
```
